# Amey's Arc

> A working archive of research and engineering notes: derivations
> carried through in full, close readings of papers, and project records
> kept as first written. Published while the work is in progress.

Author: Amey Thakur, ORCID 0000-0001-5644-1575
Licence: CC BY 4.0, attribution required
Site: https://amey-thakur.github.io/
Repository created: 8 December 2025
Posts: 25, the earliest dated 28 June 2021 and the latest 5 September 2026

## Posts, newest first

- [Seven Years, and the Work That Travelled Furthest](https://amey-thakur.github.io/posts/2026-09-05-seven-years-and-the-work-that-travelled-furthest/): 5 September 2026. I am Amey Thakur, and I opened github.com/Amey-Thakur on 5 September 2019, then left it empty for 425 days. Today, on its seventh anniversary, I read every repository on it in one sitting, oldest first.
- [A Stack-Overflow Denial of Service in Google's OSV-Scanner](https://amey-thakur.github.io/posts/2026-09-02-a-stack-overflow-denial-of-service-in-googles-osv-scanner/): 2 September 2026. OSV-Scanner reads the licence text of every package it scans, and it parsed that text with a recursive descent that had no depth limit. Roughly three megabytes of open brackets exhausted the goroutine stack.
- [Frame-Synchronous Hand Gesture Detection by Projected Winding Order](https://amey-thakur.github.io/posts/2026-08-31-frame-synchronous-hand-gesture-detection-by-projected-winding-order/): 31 August 2026. A gesture recogniser that drives an interface is judged by whether it eventually fires.
- [A Modular Zero-Shot Pipeline for Accident Detection, Localization, and Classification in Traffic Surveillance Video](https://amey-thakur.github.io/posts/2026-04-05-a-modular-zero-shot-pipeline-for-accident-detection-localization-and-classification/): 5 April 2026. Special thanks to Sarvesh Talele for his meaningful contributions, support, and wisdom that helped shape this work.
- [Attention Is All You Need — Understanding the Mathematics of the Transformer](https://amey-thakur.github.io/posts/2026-03-16-attention-is-all-you-need/): 16 March 2026. No summary recorded.
- [Adaptive Cruise Control with Arduino & Simulink](https://amey-thakur.github.io/posts/2024-07-24-adaptive-cruise-control/): 24 July 2024. No summary recorded.

- [Online Chess Game](https://amey-thakur.github.io/posts/2022-04-15-online-chess-game/): 15 April 2022. Special thanks to Mega Satish for her meaningful contributions, support, and wisdom that helped shape this work.
- [A Comparative Study on Distributed File Systems](https://amey-thakur.github.io/posts/2022-03-31-a-comparative-study-on-distributed-file-systems/): 31 March 2022. Special thanks to Mega Satish and Hasan Rizvi for their meaningful contributions, support, and wisdom that helped shape this work. Distributed File Systems form the backbone of large-scale data storage.
- [Clock Synchronization in Distributed Systems](https://amey-thakur.github.io/posts/2022-03-31-clock-syncronization-in-distributed-systems/): 31 March 2022. Special thanks to Mega Satish for her meaningful contributions, support, and wisdom that helped shape this work. Clock discrepancies are troublesome in distributed systems and pose major difficulties.
- [Pizza Ordering Chatbot Using Amazon Lex](https://amey-thakur.github.io/posts/2022-03-19-pizza-ordering-chatbot-using-amazon-lex/): 19 March 2022. Special thanks to Mega Satish for her meaningful contributions, support, and wisdom that helped shape this work.

Special thanks to Mega Satish for her meaningful contributions, support, and wisdom that helped shape this work. We propose to implement a house price prediction model of Bangalore, India.
- [Neuro-Fuzzy: Artificial Neural Networks & Fuzzy Logic](https://amey-thakur.github.io/posts/2021-09-06-neuro-fuzzy-artificial-neural-networks-&-fuzzy-logic/): 6 September 2021. Special thanks to Karan Dhiman for his meaningful contributions, support, and wisdom that helped shape this work. Neuro Fuzzy is a hybrid system that combines Artificial Neural Networks with Fuzzy Logic.
- [Generative Adversarial Networks](https://amey-thakur.github.io/posts/2021-08-27-generative-adversarial-networks/): 27 August 2021. Special thanks to Mega Satish for her meaningful contributions, support, and wisdom that helped shape this work.
- [Fundamentals of Neural Networks](https://amey-thakur.github.io/posts/2021-08-10-fundamentals-of-neural-networks/): 10 August 2021. Special thanks to Archit Konde for his meaningful contributions, support, and wisdom that helped shape this work. The purpose of this study is to familiarise the reader with the foundations of neural networks.
- [Adversarial Open Domain Adaption Framework (AODA): Sketch-to-Photo Synthesis](https://amey-thakur.github.io/posts/2021-07-28-adversarial-open-domain-adaption-frameworka-aoda-sketch-to-photo-synthesis/): 28 July 2021. - [Chat Room Using HTML, PHP, CSS, JS, AJAX](https://amey-thakur.github.io/posts/2021-06-28-chat-room-using-html-php-css-js-ajax/): 28 June 2021.
